title: Complete Identification in Latent Bow Graphs from Disturbing Probe Experiments
banked_reason: The advertised terminating all-ADMG district calculus with a complete positive probe-hedge alternative is not delivered; the sound bow frontier substitutes for the kernel while the independent-edge-source lift remains open.
gap_reasons: The advertised terminating all-ADMG district calculus with a complete positive probe-hedge alternative is not delivered: this node instead proves the proposed one-fixing algebraic certificate cannot supply the needed edge-source lift, leaving the core's genuine contribution at the bow frontier.
The one-fixing section instead disproves the proposed algebraic certificate and characterizes only an empty two-node example; the load-bearing independent-edge-source lift remains open.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed and checked a sound finite-bow row-span identification frontier, primitive-positive converse twins, and an exact minimum-rank probe construction. The attempted one-step district certificate was shown insufficient for independent-edge-source realizability, so the run could not supply the advertised all-ADMG recursive calculus, common-witness gluing, finite latent-support bound, or complete positive probe-hedge alternative. Completing those obligations requires a new realizability and recursive-composition theory rather than a bounded repair of this derivation.
tldr: Known disturbing probes reveal contractions of both input and output ports, not a passive observed law. On the finite canonical independent-edge-source bow, global identification is exactly the conjunction of treatment-row reachability and terminal-effect reachability. Success gives an explicit synthesis- and coefficient-invariant arithmetic functional of the accessible tensor and does not require positivity. Failure of either condition is witnessed inside the primitive-positive interior, with explicit cell floors and at most \(m\) shared-edge states. An explicit \(2m-1\)-rank menu identifies every atomic bow query over the full finite class without full \(m^2\)-dimensional tomography; its binary instance has rank three. Beyond the bow, the scope stops after one legal CADMG fixing step, where the independent-edge-source lift remains open.
gap: Friend et al. recover mechanisms from marginally complete disturbing instruments in the Markovian regime, while ordinary ADMG fixing starts from an already valid passive-law kernel. Neither addresses the distinct problem of query identification on a latent bow or shows that a positive normalized array reconstructed from disturbing-probe coordinates is induced by independent per-edge sources.
fill: The project proves the exact bow row-span equivalence under an explicit joint terminal target-span condition, invariant synthesis, dimensionally explicit bounded positive twins, and the non-tomographic positive menu; it then isolates one coordinate-level fixing certificate and the shared-mechanism edge-source lift as the sole open construction.
